as_told.place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

plain: In 1977, a man named Mario Woods, stationed at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, was taken by something unknown along with his partner, Michael Johnson, according to Michels, who has told the story on several episodes. Michels draws on Woods himself, on the researcher Robert Hastings's book UFOs and Nukes, and on a man named Richard Doty. In his telling, the abduction came back to Woods under hypnosis, and the details include a signal exchange, at least five missing hours, a truck at a dam, mud in a frozen field, burns a doctor found, a single glove, drawings of the craft, and Woods waking up nine miles away. Michels says he later brought the two men back together for an interview, which would matter because it would be two serving airmen recalling the same abduction.
